name: Ojós (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of green, orange, white, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ojós (a cross of Saint James, the letters OXOX and a lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Ojós; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ojós arms — cross of Saint James, the letters OXOX and a lion on white
